title: The Telangana Mica Act, 1957.
full_text: The Telangana Mica Act, 1957. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19577 Act Number: 7 Enactment Date: 1957-06-27 Act Year: 1957 Short Title: The Telangana Mica Act, 1957. Long Title: An Act to regulate the possession and transport of, and trading in, mica in the State of Telangana. Department: Department of Industries and Commerce Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Prohibition of possession and trading in mica without licence, proprietors' certificate or digger's permit. Section 4. Grant of proprietor's certificate. Section 5. Grant or refusal of licences. Section 6. Renewal of licences and Properietor's certificate. Section 7. Exercise of powers of licensees or registered proprietors by agents. Section 8. Obligation of licensees and registered proprietors to keep books of account and to submit returns. Section 9. Production of accounts by licensees and registered proprietors. Section 10. Registration of certain instruments authorising extraction of mica. Section 11. Grant of digger's permit. Section 12. Inspection of mine worked by digger. Section 13. Licensee, registered proprietor and digger to notify places used for storing mica. Section 14. Removal of mica. Section 15. Removal of mica from mine worked by diggers. Section 16. Sale of mica by diggers. Section 17. Penalties. Section 18. Penalty for certain offences committed by diggers. Section 19. Penalty for unauthorised removal of mica. Section 20. Penalty for removal of mica from mine worked by digger. Section 21. Penalty for obstructing officers in the performance of duties. Section 22. Power of search and seizure. Section 23. Things liable to confiscation. Section 24. Confiscation how to be effected. Section 25. Power to arrest without warrant. Section 26. Protection of acts done in good faith. Section 27. Officers acting under Act to be public servants. Section 28. Offences to be bailable. Section 29. Jurisdiction to try offences. Section 30. Cancellation of licence and proprietor's certificate. Section 31. Saving of other laws. Section 32. Power to make rules. Section 33. Power to remove difficulties.
